summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (oven-sh/bun), extracts and chmods the binary, then invokes it via execFileSync against a shipped 727KB file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is heavily obfuscated (string-array with rotation via a `WV8StW` shuffler over a ~2000-entry constant array, mangled identifiers) and its contents are unrelated to the package's advertised purpose (a React/MobX TanStack Query integration). Fetching a second language runtime specifically to execute an opaque bundled payload at install time hands arbitrary code execution to whatever `math_init.js` contains on every installer's machine, and evades Node-only static analysis by executing under Bun. The `@servicetitan` scope and referenced anvil-uikit-contrib repository are inconsistent with shipping a runtime dropper of this shape, indicating scope impersonation or a compromised publisher.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
